name: DevOps & Docker Containerization
description: Container packaging, multi-stage Docker builds, image hardening, and container orchestration workflows.
best_practices: Non-root user execution: Explicitly define USER with a non-zero UID/GID to prevent container privilege escalation.
Multi-stage builds: Separate build dependencies from runtime binaries to minimize final image attack surface.
Layer caching: Structure Dockerfiles so frequently modified layers are at the end.
Pinned base image hashes: Always pin base images with immutable SHA-256 digests.
Vulnerability scanning: Integrate Hadolint and Trivy automated checks in CI.
